step3_cloud_models.description: Cloud Gemini models for Step 3 (interaction check), tried in order. JSON array of up to 4 'gemini-*' names. Step 3 is always ONLY_IN_CLOUD; this cannot change that.

step3_max_output_tokens.description: Answer length budget for Step 3. Clamped to 256-2048 in the app.

listen_max_ms.description: Longest the microphone stays open for one question (Step 1). Clamped to 5000-30000 ms.

checks_paused.description: Kill switch. true = PillCheck refuses checks and speaks checks_paused_message. Can only make the app refuse, never send more.

checks_paused_message.description: Plain-text message spoken while checks are paused (max 200 chars). Empty = built-in message.
